applied.problem: Three overreaches: 'It uses DC' contradicts its own 'or a very slow AC' and [^3]; 'the lowest path sets the reading' fails (500 kΩ fault on 500 kΩ reads 250); 'are set in ohms per volt' ignores absolute and percentage settings in the research.

Screen 7's 'the lowest path sets the reading' fails across the fault picker (500 kΩ reads 250 kΩ); screen 9's 'are set in ohms per volt' is too absolute; screen 6's 500-times answer holds only at the same test voltage, which VLF sets usually exceed.
A plain monitor cannot say which circuit is at fault, but i7 adds a pulse injector with feeder clamps that does; 'on its own' keeps the sentence true after i7.
